issue.description:
ADR-005 (Accepted 2026-08-16) decides on a `ready_frontier` doctor check under the `dependencies` scope that warns when open issues carry an assignee (unclaimable: excluded from the ready frontier), names a bounded sample of ids, and states the exact remedy (`bead update <id> --clear-assignee`). Advisory only — doctor never clears an assignee, not even under `--repair`. Evidence base: the 2026-08-16 sweep found 583 such issues across 47 workspaces with ten starved while doctor reported healthy. No open bead covers this check (beadrs-892eb8ce is manual_blocked surfacing; beadrs-90abfec2 is the broken blocked-count column — coordinate so dependencies-scope output stays coherent). Tests: open+assigned detected; in_progress/closed/manually-blocked not flagged; --repair leaves assignment untouched; bounded sample; a fixture reproducing the all-assignment-held empty-frontier shape.

---
Priority: P1
Created by: weave strand

issue.description:
ADR-004 requires a pinned MSRV lane so the declared Rust 1.85 floor is tested on every CI run instead of asserted — today the declaration is honest only by luck, and any dependency update can silently break it. Add the lane to the bead-rs CI workflow (Argo `bead-rs-ci`; the template lives in declarative-config), pin the lane's toolchain to exactly the version `Cargo.toml`'s `rust-version` declares, fail the run on drift between the two, and keep the lane green against the committed Cargo.lock.
